_note: Official notices copied by hand from park websites (floridastateparks.org is Cloudflare-blocked to scripts). kind=closure rows make getParkStatus() return 'closed' while active and within starts_at/ends_at; deactivating a row (active=false) or setting ends_at in the past reopens the park automatically. severity uses the NWS scale: Severe (closure), Moderate, Minor. Verified 2026-09-18/19.

alerts.text: Effective Oct. 29, 2025: Due to construction renovations, there are no water activities available at Ruth B. Kirby Gilchrist Blue Springs State Park. The large pavilion, large picnic area and volleyball courts are open; port-o-let facilities are in place until renovations are complete. Rentals and concession services are also unavailable. No reopening date has been announced.

Effective Thursday, July 16, 2026: The designated swimming area at Poe Springs Park is temporarily closed due to poor water clarity, and is reassessed weekly. The rest of the park (picnic areas, trails, boat launch and paddling) remains open. In August 2026 the Florida Springs Institute reported that the spring had stopped flowing during drought; no reopening timeline has been given.

Effective March 17, 2026: The Midpoint Tube Launch is closed until further notice for repairs. Tubers can continue to launch from Dampier's Landing at the South Entrance until 5 p.m. Tube rentals end at 4:30 p.m.

Effective May 20, 2026: Expect high visitation on weekends and holidays. When the park reaches capacity it temporarily closes to all visitors, including those with rental reservations or digital day passes. Entry is first-come, first-served; visitors may not park and wait on the roadside, and local law enforcement will issue citations.

Effective Sept. 9, 2026: The parking lot at Rainbow Springs State Park will undergo renovations from Sept. 9, 2026 to Feb. 4, 2027. Limited parking will be available; the park may reach capacity earlier than usual.

Effective Sept. 2, 2025: Reservations are required for day-use entry to Wekiwa Springs State Park for all visitors, including annual passholders. Reservations open 60 days ahead; same-day reservations are available until the daily limit is met.
